== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Advosze (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[Advosze (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]]. The same area of the 2016 disc card image (scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
